cases.name: the domain requirement is dropped, so any @v token is a pin
cases.old: [\w\-]+ (?: \.[\w\-]+ )+        # a domain: at least one dot
caught_by: an unrelated `@v` token beside a `go install ./...` is not a pin

cases.name: the path elements become required again
cases.old: (?: /[\w.\-~]+ )*                # and any number of path elements
caught_by: a module path with no elements below the domain is still a pin

cases.name: the pattern no longer matches a real module path
caught_by: a pinned workflow and an installer that decides is clean
a pinned workflow and an installer that inherits is reported
setting GOTOOLCHAIN to local counts as deciding
GOTOOLCHAIN named only in a comment is not a decision
a pin held in a constant far from the `go install` is still a pin
GOTOOLCHAIN named only in a docstring is not a decision
the guard and its own test are not counted as installers
an unrelated `@v` token beside a `go install ./...` is not a pin
